icon_design.method: Built-in image_gen tool, edited from the reviewed camera concept.
icon_design.dark_prompt: Black and bright yellow icon. Four circular focus arcs, a detached thin ring with a clear gap around a graphite camera aperture, and a central yellow S formed from opposing circular sweeps. Full opaque square, no text.
icon_design.light_prompt: Preserve the dark emblem geometry on a cool frosted white background, keeping saturated yellow circular arcs and S and the charcoal aperture.
icon_design.tinted_prompt: Preserve the dark emblem geometry and convert yellow to near-white for the iOS tinted appearance.
